items.title: Nike investors pray for a reset ahead of earnings
items.summary: Nike (NKE) investors are hoping for a reset when the sportswear giant reports earnings. Shares are trading near their lowest level since 2014, while Wall Street analysts continue to cut estimates and price targets. Yahoo Finance Senior Business Reporter joins Market Domination Overtime to break down what investors should watch when Nike reports its fiscal first-quarter results on Thursday, October 1
